title: Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and easy to make Tunisian dish featuring lamb kebabs seasoned with herbs and spices, cooked on a tava griddle and served with a side of mushimono steam, this dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner and is fodmap friendly.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated tava griddle and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
After 10 minutes, reduce the heat to medium low and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the mushimono steam by boiling water in a large pot.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove from the griddle and serve with a squeeze of lemon juice and a side of mushimono steam.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
